population: Hypothetical independently operated multiplayer release published on itch.io, including optional HTML5 clients
unit: Operational responsibility, monthly cost input or QA acceptance check; not a market-average expense
period: Creator HTML5 documentation, 2021–2025 moderated forum boundary evidence and one October 2026 creator-described external-backend example
sample_frame: Official itch.io static hosting documentation, moderated public hosting answers, and a single publicly posted game architecture

release_modes.qualification: Only a fully offline release; does not imply zero cost for unrelated analytics, downloads, development or support.
May avoid dedicated public server charges but still requires compatible local networking, client QA and support.
Remote server, relay or third-party service may be required; publisher handles service reliability and contractual costs.

operational_cost_register.qa_gate: Verify load under declared peak concurrency; record scaling and idle behavior.
Measure per-session transfer, account for spikes and provider bandwidth allowances.
Define monitored availability, on-call ownership, failure recovery and downtime communications.
Identify reporting/blocking mechanisms, moderation ownership and privacy-sensitive retention; avoid collecting individual player records for this research.
Test dependency updates, incident patches, credential rotation and backup restore.
Document service contracts, traffic caps and exit plan before shipping.

limits: Static file hosting is not the same as itch.io providing a dedicated runtime for developer network sessions.
The publisher-described October 2026 external backend is an architecture example, not an inspected codebase, host invoice or uptime measurement.
Cost categories are evidence-backed planning requirements; no typical amount, zero-cost guarantee or paid-buyer count is imputed.
Pseudonymous player accounts and sessions must never be used to imply unique paying customers.
